name: dsh-slidestudio
description: DSH SlideStudio — AI presentations for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.setup:dev: npm ci && npm run build:native && npm run setup:browser && npm start
scripts.build:native: npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/pptd-v2 && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/project-store && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/exporter-native && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/canvas-session && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/presentation-run && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/agent-harness && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/dsh-slides-host && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/dsh-slides-client && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/dsh-slides-bundle
scripts.build:legacy: npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/pptd && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/design-brain && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/agent-core && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/exporter-pptx && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/web
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:legacy
scripts.test:native: npm run test -w @open-slidestudio/pptd-v2 && npm run test -w @open-slidestudio/project-store && npm run test -w @open-slidestudio/exporter-native && npm run test -w @open-slidestudio/canvas-session && npm run test -w @open-slidestudio/presentation-run && npm run test -w @open-slidestudio/agent-harness && npm run test -w @open-slidestudio/dsh-slides-host && npm run test -w @open-slidestudio/dsh-slides-client && npm run test -w @open-slidestudio/dsh-slides-bundle
scripts.dsh:profile:init: npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/pptd-v2 && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/project-store && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/presentation-run && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/dsh-slides-host && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/dsh-slides-client && npm run build -w @open-slidestudio/dsh-slides-bundle && node scripts/dsh-profile-init.mjs
scripts.test:dsh-contract: npm run test -w @open-slidestudio/dsh-slides-bundle && npm run test -w @open-slidestudio/dsh-slides-host && npm run test -w @open-slidestudio/dsh-slides-client
scripts.gate:native: npm run build:native && npm run test:native && npm run oracle:validate && node scripts/native-smoke.mjs && npm run native:export-current && npm run qa:editor-toolbars
scripts.lint: eslint --config eslint.config.mjs apps packages dsh-slidestudio scripts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.quality:fast: npm run lint && npm run quality:source && npm run quality:architecture && npm run quality:dependencies && npm run quality:duplicates && npm run quality:versions && npm run quality:debt
scripts.ci:local: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run gate1 && npm run gate:native
scripts.qa:editor-human: node scripts/qa/editor-human-audit.mjs && node scripts/qa/editor-agent-human-audit.mjs && node scripts/qa/editor-shell-human-audit.mjs && node scripts/qa/editor-remaining-boundaries.mjs
scripts.release:package: npm run build:native && npm run build --prefix dsh-slidestudio && node dsh-slidestudio/scripts/release.mjs
